objective: Adopt a privacy-preserving product evidence layer that connects user problems and Design Partner tasks to the existing scenario and engineering evidence contracts.
decision_supported: Whether Workbench should adopt the product-management and Design Partner operating model as repository documentation.
acceptance: User evidence is separated from engineering evidence and physical evidence.
Private participant data is referenced only by opaque identifiers.
Product documents cannot grant motion, MCU, emergency-stop, release, or completion authority.
Scripted fixture status remains release_eligible=false unless a release gate explicitly changes it.
No interfaces/ or public JSON schema changes are made.
stop_conditions: A requested change requires identifiable customer data in the repository.
A requested change modifies interfaces/ without matching Pydantic models and approvals.
A document would claim a physical or Gazebo result without an eligible artifact.
risks_and_fallbacks: If product evidence conflicts with engineering evidence, preserve both and keep the decision UNKNOWN until reviewed.
If privacy handling is unclear, keep the source in private storage and commit only an opaque reference.
If MkDocs strict validation is unavailable on a contributor machine, run it in CI before merge.
data_classification: Repository documentation is public; participant source data is private and must not be committed.
model_policy: No model, product document, or Design Partner may grant runtime, motion, MCU, emergency-stop, release, or completion authority.
